name: September 2026 sublet
description: An ongoing search for an exactly-September 2026 sublet.
prompt: Find as many qualifying September 2026 sublet leads as possible. The stay must be exactly September 1–30, 2026, with very little move-in/move-out flexibility. Prefer a location near 39 Saint Felix St in Brooklyn or near 124th St and Manhattan Ave; the workplace is 302 W 124th St. A one-bedroom should be $2,500/month or less. A shared apartment is welcome when roommates can be vetted and seem nice and chill, with below $2,000/month ideal. Consider radically different neighborhoods when the commute to work is 45 minutes or less. A guest or crashing arrangement must be possible. Proximity to parks is a bonus. Do not disqualify a lead when a criterion is unknown; disqualify only an explicit contradiction. Record the direct listing URL, source, price, dates, location, housing type, commute/guest unknowns, and park proximity. Continue this project in later search runs and preserve existing leads and user annotations.
